lessons.correction: Continue teching and increase army production. Add units that counter Immortals, such as Roaches or Hydralisks.
lessons.mistake: Staying on a small ground army and continuing to tech without increasing production, leaving you vulnerable to being overwhelmed.
lessons.recheck: Recheck when your tech is complete or when the opponent attacks.
lessons.title: Counter Immortal-heavy ground armies
lessons.when: Midgame, around 7 minutes, when opponent has a ground army with Immortals and you have heavy defense and tech investment.
lessons.why: Immortals are strong against armored units, so you need a mix of units. Your tech investment will provide upgrades to help in the fight.

lessons.correction: Add anti-air units such as Hydralisks or Mutalisks. Consider building Spore Crawlers for defense.
lessons.mistake: Staying on a ground-only army and continuing to strengthen ground forces, leaving you vulnerable to air harassment.
lessons.recheck: Recheck when you have sufficient anti-air or when the opponent's air army is confirmed.
lessons.title: Transition to anti-air against Phoenix/Warp Prism
lessons.when: Midgame, around 8 minutes, when opponent transitions to an air-based army with Phoenixes and Warp Prisms, and you have a heavy ground defense.
lessons.why: The opponent's air army requires anti-air capabilities. Your strong economy can support a tech switch to counter.

lessons.correction: Continue expanding and teching. Maintain a ground army for safety and scout for tech choices.
lessons.mistake: Overcommitting to a specific tech path before knowing the opponent's plan, risking a poor matchup.
lessons.recheck: Recheck when you have a clear read on the opponent's tech or when you are ready to transition.
lessons.title: Maintain flexibility against unknown tech
lessons.when: Early game, around 3 minutes, with a heavy economy and expansion, while opponent's tech is unknown but heavy.
lessons.why: A strong economy and tech lead will give you an advantage in the mid-game. Ground army provides defense against early pressure.
